summary: Scope repository-gate activity errors to the gated identity

delivery.outcome: A repository-level gate passes when sibling repositories carry unsupported ticket-activity policy versions, while the workspace scan still reports the full drift.
nonGoals: No change to overlap detection between worktrees of the same identity

architecture.decision: One guard clause in the activity_errors loop of overlap_findings(): when only_identity is set, skip activity findings from checkouts of a different identity — the same scoping the overlap groups already apply.
architecture.rollback: Remove the four-line guard; workspace scan behavior is unchanged either way.

validation.evidence: Repository gate returns passed while foreign-repo policy drift exists in the workspace.
Workspace scan still reports the full GOV-TICKET-ACTIVITY-001 drift.
